learning: If line_loss_events fall to 0.5 or below on the s-bend and slalom, turn authority was the limit, and wheel_track should be tuned further or kp adjusted. If they stay at 1.0, check where in the course the loss occurs (start or a fixed bend, using progress at first loss) before changing geometry again.
notes: Complete runnable package for the Builder's wheel_track 0.16 m proposal. The controller is unchanged from iteration 4 so that the race isolates track width. All values are inside the contract limits.
rationale: Iteration 4 (wheel_radius 0.035, all else as iteration 3) left line_loss_events at 1.0 per run on oval, s-bend and slalom, and scored 46.77. Sensor span, forward offset, mass and wheel radius have each left the single bend loss unchanged, so the remaining untested turn-authority lever is wheel_track. This package follows the Builder's proposal exactly: wheel_track 0.16 m, with the iteration 4 base (seven 16 mm sensors at y 0.03 m across ±3 cm, mass 0.6 kg, wheel_radius 0.035 m). The controller is held identical to iterations 1 to 4 (kp 2.5, ki 0, kd 0.2, base_speed 1.5, last_direction, weights scaled to x) so any change in line loss can be attributed to the track width alone. The wider track gives more yaw rate per unit wheel-speed difference, so the same controller should correct the bends with less saturation. Expected, not measured: line-loss events at or below 0.5 per run on s-bend and slalom, max_error under 0.06 m, progress above the iteration 4 values.
